question.text: Under Part A of the PMLA Schedule, offences under the Companies Act, 2013 specifically include:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.67 of the workbook, Part A, Paragraph 29 of the PMLA Schedule lists Companies Act, 2013 Section 447 (punishment for fraud) as a scheduled offence. Corporate fraud generating proceeds of crime is therefore a predicate offence for money laundering. The Trap: Other sections of the Companies Act referenced in the options deal with duties, disclosures or definitions and are not the specific criminal offence listed in the PMLA Schedule. Section 447 is the operative provision. Note: The scheduled-offence entry on p.67 is the source. Operational examples beyond the workbook are not relied on here.
